Tutorial
========

Preparing your repository on GitHub
-----------------------------------

This section explains how to prepare a repository that can be built by Read the Docs.

Creating a Read the Docs account
--------------------------------

This section explains how to create and configure a Read the Docs account.

Importing the project to Read the Docs
--------------------------------------

This section explains how to import a repository as a documentation project.

Checking the first build
------------------------

This section explains how to check whether the first documentation build succeeds.

Configuring the project
-----------------------

This section introduces common configuration options for a documentation project.

Triggering builds from pull requests
------------------------------------

This section explains how documentation builds can be triggered from pull requests.
